page_title: RSO 2-2 ESP | Real Sociedad v Espanyol 24/08/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' The match has just finished.
90+5' That will be a yellow card for one of the players. The one who gets booked is Fernando Calero (Espanyol).
90+2' The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Real Sociedad will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
90+1' Jose Salinas (Espanyol) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Alejandro Quintero blows his whistle for a foul. A free kick has been awarded to Real Sociedad.
90' The fourth official shows 5 min. of added time.
87' Carlos Romero (Espanyol) does well to dispossess the attacker with a slide tackle, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
86' Substitution. Antoniu Roca (Espanyol) on for Tyrhys Dolan.

85' Real Sociedad are playing possession football and controlling the game at present. They are exchanging inch-perfect passes from player to player, making it difficult for the opposition to win the ball.
81' Manolo Gonzalez has decided to make a change. Jose Salinas (Espanyol) replaces Exposito.
80' Ander Barrenetxea will be replaced by Goncalo Guedes (Real Sociedad).
79' It's a yellow card for Jon Martin (Real Sociedad).
77' Real Sociedad fail to score from a corner as Marko Dmitrovic (Espanyol) leaps to collect the ball.

77' Takefusa Kubo (Real Sociedad) takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's not a big threat for the goalkeeper as his effort is blocked by a defender. Real Sociedad have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
75' Jon Gorrotxategi (Real Sociedad) is cautioned by the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
73' Real Sociedad quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.

73' Brais Mendez (Real Sociedad) places a shot from the edge of the box towards the bottom left corner, but Marko Dmitrovic makes a terrific save to deny him. Nice play all round! The ball goes out of play and Real Sociedad have been awarded a corner kick.
72' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Aihen Munoz (Real Sociedad) comes onto the pitch so that Sergio Gomez can be given a rest.
71' Substitution. Mikel Oyarzabal makes his way off the pitch and Brais Mendez (Real Sociedad) comes on as his replacement.
70' Manolo Gonzalez has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Kike Garcia (Espanyol) replacing Roberto Fernandez Jaen.
70' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Fernando Calero (Espanyol) will replace Pol Lozano.
70' Pere Milla comes off the pitch to be replaced by Ramon Terrats (Espanyol).
69' 2 - 2 Fantastic team goal! Orri Oskarsson (Real Sociedad) was set free in the area by Mikel Oyarzabal and he made no mistake with a lovely finish into the bottom left corner. 2:2.
66' Pere Milla (Espanyol) times his run too early and the linesman raises his flag for offside.
64' Sergio Gomez (Real Sociedad) found some space to dink a cross from the side into the box, but it needed to be more precise to threaten the opposition.
61' 1 - 2 Ander Barrenetxea (Real Sociedad) picks it up in space and from the edge of the box lashes in a shot that is deflected past the helpless Marko Dmitrovic. 1:2.
60' Tyrhys Dolan (Espanyol) hits a shot well wide of the right post from the edge of the box. The ball goes out of play and Real Sociedad will have a goal kick.
58' Real Sociedad can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
58' Mikel Oyarzabal (Real Sociedad) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Real Sociedad.
56' Sergio Francisco has decided to substitute Benat Turrientes and he is replaced by Jon Gorrotxategi (Real Sociedad).
56' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Orri Oskarsson (Real Sociedad) comes onto the pitch for Luka Sucic.
55' The ball is cleared after Pere Milla (Espanyol) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. The ball goes out of play and Real Sociedad will have a goal kick.
52' Real Sociedad exchange some short passes over a small area and control the game. Now they make a mistake and lose the ball and the whole situation changes completely.
49' Pablo Marin (Real Sociedad) gets on the ball and beats an opponent, but his run is stopped by the referee Alejandro Quintero who sees an offensive foul.
46' The second half has just started.
45+5' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+4' Ander Barrenetxea (Real Sociedad) plays a through ball but overhits it.
45+1' 0 - 2 Goal! Javi Puado (Espanyol) runs up to the ball, stops and waits for Alex Remiro to commit before slotting the penalty into the roof of the net.
45+1' Javi Puado (Espanyol) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
45+1' Espanyol aren't happy as the ref indicates they must retake the penalty!

45+1' There's a break in play and referee Alejandro Quintero must have got a signal in his ear as he indicates he will check that earlier penalty claim by Espanyol using VAR. This could be interesting!
45' We will have 4 min. of added time.
44' The referee demonstrates he won't tolerate this behaviour. Exposito (Espanyol) is given a yellow card.
44' Penalty saved! Javi Puado (Espanyol) sends the penalty towards the left hand side of the goal, but Alex Remiro pulls off a wonderful save to deny him.
44' Javi Puado (Espanyol) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
43' Foul! Jon Martin (Real Sociedad) is penalised for pulling back his opponent. The referee's verdict is crystal clear. A penalty is awarded to Espanyol!
42' The ball goes out of play. Espanyol are awarded a corner kick.
42' Tyrhys Dolan (Espanyol) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
39' Takefusa Kubo (Real Sociedad) swings in a cross from the corner, but Marko Dmitrovic reads it well and gathers the ball.
39' Takefusa Kubo (Real Sociedad) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. Now Real Sociedad have a corner.
37' The game is interrupted now, Pere Milla (Espanyol) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
35' Benat Turrientes (Real Sociedad) is penalised for a foul. Alejandro Quintero had a clear view and blows his whistle.
32' PENALTY APPEAL after Takefusa Kubo (Real Sociedad) goes down under a challenge from the defender. All players chase the referee but he's not interested in the penalty claim. Play continues.

31' Mikel Oyarzabal (Real Sociedad) blows a huge opportunity! He latches on to a perfect cross from the wing into the penalty area, but sends his bullet header just wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Espanyol will have a goal kick.
29' Exposito (Espanyol) unleashes a decent effort from just outside the box which goes narrowly wide of the left post.
26' Carlos Romero (Espanyol) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear.
24' Exposito (Espanyol) steps up to send the ball in.

23' Tyrhys Dolan (Espanyol) attempts to find one of his teammates inside the box with a chip pass, but one of the defending players reacts superbly and intercepts the ball. Espanyol have been awarded a corner kick.
23' Real Sociedad seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. Great movement by the offensive players allows the defenders to set up the attack.
21' Total attempts – 4:4.
18' Javi Puado (Espanyol) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Alex Remiro, who smothers the ball.

14' Ander Barrenetxea (Real Sociedad) receives a lofted pass in the goal area and unleashes a dangerous header which sails a few inches over the bar! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Espanyol.
12' Tyrhys Dolan (Espanyol) misses the target from a promising position, sending the ball well wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Real Sociedad will have a goal kick.

10' 0 - 1 The ball hits the back of the net! Roberto Fernandez Jaen showcases his brilliant technique and produces a beautiful lofted cross into the box. Pere Milla (Espanyol) gets onto the scoresheet by sweetly heading it low inside the right post – 0:1.
8' A great solo run by Takefusa Kubo (Real Sociedad) took him deep inside the box, but his weak effort towards the middle of the goal was easily caught by Marko Dmitrovic.
5' Ander Barrenetxea (Real Sociedad) latches onto a loose ball inside the box but slams it just wide of the right post.
4' Mikel Oyarzabal (Real Sociedad) shows too much aggression during an attacking move and ends up fouling his opponent.
1' Pablo Marin (Real Sociedad) dribbles into the box, but Marko Dmitrovic is quick enough to come off his line and stop him.
1' The match has just started.
Real Sociedad will kick-off.
Alejandro Quintero will supervise the game today.
